description: This file defines various loss functions in the torch::nn::functional namespace, including their inline wrappers and internal detail implementations. It includes function declarations for loss computations like l1_loss, mse_loss, kl_div, and others, with associated options and options classes. The file serves as an interface for loss function definitions used in the PyTorch C++ frontend.
